name: Arabic Capability Pack
description: Audited Arabic capabilities for deployable document NLP; heavy corpus, parallel, and annotation datasets are acquired separately.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Self-contained Arabic distribution with foundation, core, normalization, CAMeL lexicon/morphology/segmentation, Arabic WordNet and Wikidata KB, search, and quality resources.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: Selected IANA, Unicode, CLDR, CAMeL Morph, Arabic WordNet, and Wikidata sources are approved and retain generated attribution and license evidence.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: Ordinary typed MSA document NLP. Large corpora, parallel alignments, and UD annotation datasets are deliberately excluded from the npm package and remain explicit forge acquisition inputs.
